blocks.text: Marvel has dropped the final trailer for the highly anticipated “Avengers: Doomsday,” giving fans a glimpse of the epic assembly of the Avengers, Fantastic Four and X-Men. The trailer, released on Monday, Nov. 23, begins with a glimpse of Chris Evans’ Roger and Hayley Atwell’s Peggy Carter settling into a domestic life with their son. This, however, was interrupted as the Fantastic Four — portrayed by Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach — arrives and recruits him to fight against Robert Downey Jr.’s Dr. Doom. “Years ago, we did what was needed to make the world right.
